entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany, read 62 centimetres on 17 November, up from 61 centimetres on 16 November
entry.summary: The 06:15 reading is 1 centimetre above the day before and 3 above 15 November, after a recovery from a 5 centimetre low on 8 November. Barges still load below capacity at this depth. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, Kaub readings of 15, 16 and 17 November 2026
